crossFormatGaps: `formatCapabilities.ts` only declares writable fields; it is not a complete read/play/extract/write/recovery matrix.
ArchivistFileMetadataModule gates non-audio embedded copies at 64 MiB; audio writer path has a separate 8 GiB cap.
Native write-recovery policy is tested independently, but no per-format interrupted SAF replacement/read-back corpus establishes crash recovery for each listed format.
ScannerDeepReader OCR and app playback have no retained real PDF/audio/comic corpus in these tests; contract or generated-fixture coverage is not owner-file coverage.
Generic ZIP metadata writes are disabled: ambiguous content remains database-only; a .zip filename is not sufficient evidence of a comic.
